campaigns.context: A single operator reported by TKemmerling uses freshly-registered random-label .com domains to relay victims from fake financial-offer emails to phishing landing pages. Impersonated brands span car insurance (Insurify, CarShield), personal loans (LifeLoans, Bad Credit Lending), debt consolidation, and storage-renewal warnings. Most domains carry a consistent two-letter subdomain prefix (se, sb, rd, sa, vb). IOCs observed from 2026-08-29 to 2026-09-16.
campaigns.name: Financial phishing on random-label .com relay domains

campaigns.context: A cross-platform ClickFix campaign presents fake Cloudflare CAPTCHA prompts on randomly-named domains to trick Windows and macOS users into running malicious code. Payloads are retrieved using EtherHiding - reading commands from Polygon and BSC Testnet smart contracts - to deliver a Go-based stealer with credential theft, crypto-wallet clipboard hijacking, and remote shell capability. Infrastructure rotated from dntds.shop to cloudfrontenterprise.com, with staging paths at /curl/ and /hex/Traffic.
campaigns.name: EtherHiding ClickFix campaign delivering Go-based stealer

campaigns.context: Android malware distributes fake Rakuten and Amazon apps via two domain families: ruceive-*anpointapp.com and amoizanpointapp.com lookalikes target both brands, while raku-point-[a-z]{4-7}.com domains target Rakuten exclusively. Samples across 27 domains were submitted to VirusTotal with SHA256 hashes. One reporter (masaomi346) flagged IOCs from 2026-09-05 to 2026-09-11.
campaigns.name: Rakuten/Amazon Android malware on *point* lookalike domains

campaigns.context: ValleyRAT C2 infrastructure attributed via local enrichment, covering IPs including 121.127.253.206 and 202.146.222.95, MD5 hashes, and SHA256 hashes with no registered domains. Sideloading DLLs such as nW_Elf.dll appear among the shared hashes. Grouping is based on malware family attribution rather than shared domain patterns. Three reporters flagged 53 indicators from 2026-08-19 to 2026-09-07.
campaigns.name: ValleyRAT C2 infrastructure - IPs and hashes

campaigns.context: A malvertising campaign registers domains impersonating Claude AI (claude-macos-app.com, claude-tools.com, cli-guides.com) and OpenAI Codex (codex-desk.com, codex-notes.com) to lure users to fake software installer pages. Infostealer payloads are delivered via secondary relay domains such as perchframe15.com and plume-compass.com, separate from the lure domains. Two researchers flagged 41 IOCs between 2026-08-19 and 2026-09-14.
campaigns.name: Malvertising via fake Claude AI and Codex install pages

campaigns.context: Attackers registered 75+ domains following a report-[brand].com naming pattern, impersonating companies including Chase, Binance, Kraken, Marriott, Roblox, and Gilead. The campaign harvests Okta session tokens via voice phishing, consistent with ShinyHunters' known tactics against corporate identity providers. Two reporters flagged 36 IOCs from 2026-09-16 to 2026-09-17.
campaigns.name: ShinyHunters multi-brand vishing via report-*.com domains

campaigns.context: Kimsuky (DPRK) C2 infrastructure uses random subdomains under ntinvoicepload.dynu.net for command-and-control alongside multiple IPs including 152.32.138.81. CobaltStrike is attributed to 13 samples in the cluster; an open directory was detected at 154.94.224.35:54321. The invoice-themed parent hostname suggests targeting of corporate finance environments. Five reporters flagged 28 IOCs from 2026-08-29 to 2026-09-17.

campaigns.context: Apple impersonation phishing sites on gkpfz.com and gzmingbo.com serve credential-stealing /login pages alongside Roblox lookalikes including hhttps-www-roblox.co and robloxr.com.es, and a Jalan travel service clone at dslld.com. Consistent /login kit paths across random-label domains suggest a single operator running multiple brand lures. Three reporters flagged 24 IOCs between 2026-08-21 and 2026-09-17.
campaigns.name: Apple and Roblox login-page phishing on random-label domains

campaigns.context: Japanese-language emails impersonating a tax authority route victims through freshly registered random-label domains on .shop, .cyou, and .top TLDs. One cluster delivers a VHDX malware payload via jp.thkiind.com; other domains including rrrjp.shop, pfokq.cyou, vjtpcxof.top, and wecqb.cyou serve phishing pages. A later wave delivers OverlordRAT via mjdou.vip with C2 callbacks to devin-us.com. Consistent reporting by bomccss and tdatwja from 2026-09-09 to 2026-09-15 points to a single operator.
campaigns.name: Japanese tax authority phishing across multi-TLD domains

campaigns.context: A single operator (TKemmerling) routes victims through attacker-registered .com domains using consistent two-letter subdomain prefixes (te, sb, se, re) as relay points. Impersonated brands include Indigo Mastercard, vehicle service protection providers, and personal loan services. Five domains were observed from 2026-09-08 to 2026-09-16.
campaigns.name: Financial phishing via two-letter subdomain relay domains

campaigns.context: Vidar infostealer C2 infrastructure spans over 24 attacker-registered domains on .icu, .org, and .net TLDs. The malware abuses Telegram channels, Steam community profiles, and the Epic Games developer API to resolve the active C2 address, evading domain blocklists. Three reporters flagged 19 IOCs between 2026-08-24 and 2026-09-03.
campaigns.name: Vidar stealer C2 using Telegram, Steam, and Epic Games APIs

campaigns.context: Phishing emails impersonating QuoteWizard and LendingTree auto-insurance comparison services route all victim links through itnessequipmentfor.info, a freshly registered random-label domain. The mismatch between the impersonated brands and the landing domain is consistent with bulk-phishing operator patterns. One reporter flagged 18 IOCs from 2026-08-20 to 2026-09-01.
campaigns.name: QuoteWizard insurance phishing via itnessequipmentfor.info

campaigns.context: Kimsuky-attributed GitHub accounts stage malware payloads including the Braodo infostealer, delivered via a dental-treatment-themed BAT lure that downloads Python libraries and a ZIP archive from raw.githubusercontent.com. Multiple GitHub profiles were reported to Colombia CERT. Five reporters flagged 17 IOCs from 2026-08-20 to 2026-09-17.
campaigns.name: Kimsuky-attributed malware staging on GitHub repositories

campaigns.context: Android malware impersonates Japanese adult apps including the Secret Live streaming service and the DatingLive dating app, distributed via domains following the [appname]-jp.com naming pattern. Samples were submitted to VirusTotal by a single reporter with SHA256 hashes confirming both payloads. One reporter flagged 14 IOCs between 2026-09-11 and 2026-09-14.
campaigns.name: Fake Japanese adult-app Android malware on -jp.com domains

campaigns.context: Kimsuky (DPRK) GitPower C2 infrastructure uses random alphanumeric subdomains on free and commercial web-hosting services including myartsonline.com, mywebcommunity.org, and onlinewebshop.net, beaconing via /setting.php with hostname and username collection parameters. A Korean-language LNK lure themed around a purchase specification is used for initial access. Reporters flagged 14 IOCs from 2026-08-19 to 2026-09-17.
campaigns.name: Kimsuky C2 clusters on random-subdomain compromised hosting

campaigns.context: Three major Brazilian retail chains are impersonated by attacker-registered clone domains using /produto.php product page paths matching the genuine retailers: casasbah.com clones Casas Bahia, havan.vip, havan-com.site, and havan-com-br.site clone Havan, and site-ma-ga-zine-luiza.com and site-maga-zine-luiza.com clone Magazine Luiza (Magalu). All sites present fake product listings to defraud shoppers. A single reporter flagged 14 IOCs from 2026-08-19 to 2026-09-17.
campaigns.name: Fake Havan, Casas Bahia, and Magalu e-commerce clone sites

campaigns.context: An APT-attributed C2 operation on Contabo infrastructure uses two domains: stackluma.sbs, which hosts a command-retrieval endpoint at /rooms/res/get-command.php?uid=[UID] with shop. and tony. subdomains active, and bytecove.cyou with mining, bg, and backend subdomains linked via callback activity. Reporters skocherhan and byrne_emmy12099 flagged 12 IOCs on 2026-08-23.
campaigns.name: APT C2 cluster on stackluma.sbs command-retrieval endpoint

campaigns.context: A network of attacker-controlled wp-js.com subdomains including stats, static, js, files, and cdn delivers malicious JavaScript into compromised WordPress sites. Zero antivirus detections were reported at time of submission. One reporter flagged 12 IOCs on 2026-09-16.
campaigns.name: WordPress JS injection infrastructure on wp-js.com

campaigns.context: A Booking.com-themed phishing campaign delivers a stealer payload via a ZIP and LNK chain that sideloads libpsl-5.dll; C2 and staging endpoints at 0zbqnac1t4dv2t2wuodv1m.com and shlianban.com were identified alongside MD5 hashes for two samples. Two reporters observed 10 IOCs between 2026-08-24 and 2026-08-25.
campaigns.name: Booking.com-themed stealer via ZIP and LNK delivery chain

campaigns.context: Multi-level subdomains on wolkamo.com host phishing pages impersonating Scotiabank, Rogers wireless refund services, and hotel booking platforms. The shared hosting platform and identical multi-brand lure pattern confirm a single operator. One reporter (skocherhan) flagged 10 IOCs on 2026-08-25.
campaigns.name: Scotiabank, Rogers, and hotel-themed phishing on wolkamo.com

campaigns.context: GravityRAT backdoor beacons to randomized subdomains under a shared requestbin.net prefix for command-and-control, using webhook-style infrastructure to receive callbacks. The malware also persists via HKLM registry Run keys and drops payloads to System32. One reporter (TheM3gatr0n) flagged 10 IOCs on 2026-08-21.
campaigns.name: GravityRAT C2 beaconing to RequestBin subdomains

campaigns.context: ValleyRAT and PlugX C2 infrastructure uses Alibaba Cloud OSS buckets in Beijing, Singapore, and Hong Kong regions (zledu-sx, bbrii, zhuohao2) for payload staging, with C2 beaconing to 156.251.11.63:8383. One lure is a Japanese-language email impersonating an HR department via a Sendgrid tracking redirect. Both families are attributed to the same Aliyun infrastructure; 10 IOCs from 2026-08-24 to 2026-09-15.
campaigns.name: ValleyRAT and PlugX C2 staging via Alibaba Cloud OSS

campaigns.context: Android malware impersonating Japan's e-Tax online filing service is distributed via five domains matching the pattern etax-[word].com, such as etax-wusasd.com and etax-pliwka.com. The consistent naming pattern suggests coordinated domain registration targeting Japanese taxpayers. One reporter (masaomi346) flagged 10 IOCs on 2026-09-05.
campaigns.name: Japan e-Tax Android malware on etax-[word].com domains

campaigns.context: NeedleStealer, a Go-based infostealer, operates with Cloudflare-fronted C2 endpoints on four attacker-registered domains (allremdeskriki.com, woolvilli.com, dubl1allremriki.com, dubl2allremriki.com) using a /api/v2 path, with a backend panel at 136.244.100.54:8899. abuse.ch flagged 10 IOCs on 2026-08-19.
campaigns.name: NeedleStealer Go-based infostealer botnet C2 infrastructure

campaigns.context: Five attacker-registered domains embed the PayPal brand name alongside financial terms (check, details, invoice, payout, receipt) in a paypal-[keyword].com pattern to harvest credentials or payment data. The coordinated registration pattern and matching naming convention suggest a single operator. Two reporters flagged 10 IOCs on 2026-08-22.
campaigns.name: PayPal phishing on paypal-[keyword].com lookalike domains

campaigns.context: MioLab is a macOS infostealer distributed as a trojanized Adobe InDesign DMG installer, with C2 at lewokodwqko.icu. Grouping is based on malware family enrichment from two reporters; 8 IOCs observed between 2026-08-24 and 2026-09-15.
campaigns.name: MioLab macOS stealer via fake Adobe InDesign DMG installer

campaigns.context: Phishing emails impersonating QuoteWizard insurance comparison route victim clicks to ongannanzhuang.info. The sender infrastructure and mismatched landing domain are the primary attacker-controlled artifacts. One reporter (TKemmerling) flagged 8 IOCs between 2026-09-04 and 2026-09-10.
campaigns.name: QuoteWizard insurance quote phishing via ongannanzhuang.info

campaigns.context: A phishing page impersonating Insurify car insurance routes form data to anadolucuhuriyeti.info; the lure is served via a separate intermediary domain, terminandoconlatrata.com. The attacker-registered landing domain carries no brand keywords, matching bulk-phishing operator patterns. One reporter (TKemmerling) flagged 8 IOCs from 2026-08-21 to 2026-09-02.
campaigns.name: Insurify car insurance phishing via anadolucuhuriyeti.info

campaigns.context: Phishing emails use fake lending offers, debt-consolidation deals, and cloud-storage deletion warnings to route victims through yancha123.com and its re. subdomain. Lure emails use Unicode-obfuscated senders to bypass filters. One reporter (TKemmerling) flagged 8 IOCs from 2026-08-26 to 2026-09-11.
campaigns.name: Fake loan and lending-offer phishing on random-label domains

campaigns.context: Phishing lures using DocuSign and Adobe themes deliver ScreenConnect RMM installer payloads via /Bin/ScreenConnect.ClientSetup.msi and .exe paths, hosted on attacker-registered domains and legitimate screenconnect.com tenant subdomains. The installer paths mimic ScreenConnect's official distribution structure to appear authentic. One reporter flagged 8 IOCs from 2026-08-21 to 2026-09-17.
campaigns.name: DocuSign phishing delivering ScreenConnect RMM installer

campaigns.context: Android malware impersonating Rakuten is distributed via three domains matching the pontih[word]-rakunde.com naming pattern, where 'rakunde' loosely evokes the Rakuten brand. Samples were submitted to VirusTotal with SHA256 hashes confirming the payloads. One reporter flagged 6 IOCs on 2026-09-12.
campaigns.name: Rakuten Android malware on pontih*-rakunde.com domains

campaigns.context: Possible Magecart skimmer infrastructure on 144.172.100.105 and 46.226.162.32, detected across multiple ports including 4444, 8080, 8081, and 8888 via a /skimmer.js path. Attribution is based on enrichment from a single reporter on 2026-09-11; the endpoints were unreachable at time of reporting. Evidence is preliminary and this grouping carries low confidence.
campaigns.name: Possible Magecart skimmer infrastructure on exposed IPs

campaigns.context: Kimsuky-attributed C2 infrastructure uses subdomains on the Korean web hosting service dothome.co.kr, with labels including bbcnews04 suggesting news-site impersonation. Enrichment links the same actor to the chromeweb78 GitHub repository (previously named pasco80), which was flagged to Colombia CERT. One reporter observed 6 IOCs on 2026-09-14.
campaigns.name: Kimsuky C2 infrastructure on dothome.co.kr subdomains

campaigns.context: Malicious npm packages deploy a hidden Node.js process to steal Chrome extension data, system information, and clipboard content, and install a Windows keylogger. The packages use npoint.io JSON API endpoints as a command-and-control relay, hiding C2 traffic within a legitimate data-storage service. One reporter flagged 6 IOCs on 2026-09-16.
campaigns.name: Malicious npm packages using npoint.io as C2 relay

campaigns.context: Amazon-branded phishing pages targeting Japanese users are served from subdomains of pvvchxh.cn and czklwfl.cn, including paths matching Amazon Japan's /ap/ sign-in structure. The hosting IP 43.165.128.22 (AS132203) anchors the pvvchxh.cn cluster. Two reporters flagged 5 IOCs between 2026-08-31 and 2026-09-16.
campaigns.name: Amazon Japan phishing on random-label .cn domains

campaigns.context: DCRat malware C2 traffic is tunneled through Cloudflare's free tunnel service using random English-word subdomains on trycloudflare.com: interactions-according-reports-syndication and periods-genetic-stones-government. This technique abuses a trusted CDN to proxy C2 traffic and bypass domain-based blocklists. One reporter flagged 4 IOCs on 2026-09-16.
campaigns.name: DCRat C2 tunneled via trycloudflare.com random-word domains

campaigns.context: A phishing campaign impersonates Aspire Mastercard, routing victim clicks through goodsecomfinder.com, a freshly registered domain with no brand keywords in the hostname. The mismatch between the impersonated brand and the landing domain is consistent with bulk-phishing operator patterns. One reporter flagged 4 IOCs from 2026-09-09 to 2026-09-14.
campaigns.name: Aspire Mastercard phishing via goodsecomfinder.com

campaigns.context: A compromised site at lepiceriedestoits.com hosts an Adobe-themed phishing page that delivers a FleetDeck RMM payload via /kirby/download.php, exploiting an existing Kirby CMS installation to obscure the delivery infrastructure. One reporter flagged 3 IOCs on 2026-09-15.
campaigns.name: Adobe-themed phishing delivering FleetDeck RMM payload

campaigns.context: A Google Voice voicemail-notification lure routes victims through gmas34.ju.mp, a public short link, then through cbspokane.com as an intermediate hop, to a cloned Google sign-in page rendered as a blob URL to evade URL scanners. Two reporters flagged 3 IOCs on 2026-08-24.
campaigns.name: Google Voice voicemail phishing via UUID-path redirect chain

campaigns.context: Sliver C2 framework samples with low AV detection are served from 193.233.202.17; the C2 endpoint rotated five times while using the same Ethereum smart contract address as a resolver. Two reporters flagged 3 IOCs between 2026-08-24 and 2026-09-07. Grouping is based on malware family attribution and shared IP infrastructure with no registered domains.
campaigns.name: Sliver C2 with Ethereum-resolved backdoor

campaigns.context: Attackers planted a Havan retail clone at havan.oficial.com, embedding the Brazilian chain's brand name in a subdomain of the attacker-controlled domain oficial.com. The site presents as the official Havan website to defraud online shoppers. One reporter flagged 3 IOCs on 2026-09-14.
campaigns.name: Havan retail clone phishing on oficial.com subdomain
